description: This Java class implements data access object functionalities for ProductOptionValue entities within a Spring-based e-commerce application. It provides methods for retrieving product option values by store, ID, name, and code, using QueryDSL for building JPQL queries.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for managing ProductOptionValue entities, extending generic DAO functionality and providing specific query methods for filtering by store, ID, name, and code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptionValues associated with a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptionValues for a store and language, excluding display-only options.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a ProductOptionValue by its ID for a specific store.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Searches for ProductOptionValues by name within a store and language context.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOptionValue by its unique code within a store.
